declarations.name: AuiRadarChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (axes, scale, each series' highest and lowest axis, hidden series).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for values in tooltips, vertex labels, the data table, the summary, and ring ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except ring ticks.

inputs.name: axes
inputs.description: Axis names, clockwise from the top. At least three.

inputs.name: series
inputs.description: Series: { id, label, values: (number | null)[], color?: 1-8 } with exactly one value per axis. null, NaN, and infinities are drawn at the center and read "No value".

inputs.name: valueAxis
inputs.description: Shared radial scale { min?, max?, tickCount? (2-20, default 4 rings) }. min defaults to 0, or the data minimum when negative; max to the data maximum; nice-rounded unless min or max is fixed. label and includeZero are validated but not used by the radar chart.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: auto: legend of toggle buttons when there is more than one series.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (one row per axis, one column per series): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Dash patterns on the polygon outlines so series never differ by color alone (always on in forced colors); marker shapes differ regardless.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: fill
inputs.description: Fill each polygon with a translucent (12%) series color; the outline and vertices carry the data.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Axes keep clockwise order in RTL (like pie charts); rtl swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight so forward follows the reading direction.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Ids of series hidden initially; update() replaces the hidden set.

outputs.name: seriesToggled
outputs.description: The user toggled a legend entry (pointer or keyboard). Not emitted for update() or setSeriesVisible().

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide a series programmatically; emits no event.

accessibility.pattern: SVG radar chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "radar chart") of role="img" vertices with two-dimensional roving focus (around the axes, between series); legend of toggle buttons; data table fallback with one row per axis.

limitations: One shared radial scale for all axes; no per-axis scales.
Missing values are drawn at the center (no gaps in the polygon).
valueAxis.label and valueAxis.includeZero are accepted but not used.
